patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks with generous negative space, often aligning text to one side and imagery to the other, creating visual balance and focus.
High contrast between large, bold serif headings and smaller, clean sans-serif body text, often with uppercase labels for metadata or section introductions.
A minimalist palette of near-white and near-black, punctuated by rich, natural greens in the hero and vibrant, diverse colors within project imagery.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where elements fade in and slide up into view as they enter the viewport.
A subtle parallax effect on the hero background image, creating depth as the user scrolls down the page.
A distinctive, full-viewport brand name reveal at the very bottom of the page, acting as a dramatic, animated footer that gradually appears.
A dynamic project gallery on interior pages featuring 3D-rotated project cards that appear to float and interact in space.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate scroll-triggered animations, including staggered fade-up reveals for text blocks and list items as they enter the viewport.
Implements a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image, where the background scrolls slower than the foreground content to create a sense of depth.
Features a unique full-page footer where the brand name is rendered in a massive, custom typeface and gradually reveals itself as the user scrolls to the very end of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements, with minimal, subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, full-viewport brand name reveal at the bottom of the page, which transforms the footer into a bold, animated brand statement. This, combined with the subtle scroll-triggered reveals and the dynamic 3D project gallery, elevates the site beyond a standard template.
